name: Repeated Somansa endpoint DLP violations on one host
author: Sentra SOC
description: 5 or more Somansa (Privacy-i / Mail-i / Server-i) DLP incidents on the same endpoint within 1 hour - a user or host repeatedly tripping data-protection policy (complements SENTRA-DLP-003 which counts per user across all DLP vendors).

name: Mass USB / print / upload exfiltration (Somansa)
author: Sentra SOC
description: 10 or more DISTINCT files moved by one user over a removable / print / upload / cloud channel within 1 hour, flagged by Somansa endpoint DLP - bulk exfiltration to USB, printer or the web.

name: Somansa DLP agent or protection disabled
author: Sentra SOC
description: A Somansa DLP endpoint agent was stopped / uninstalled or its protection was disabled (normalised action agent-tamper with the dlp tag) - a user or attacker turning off data-protection enforcement on the endpoint.
